PathrockNetwork is an experienced PoS validator currently validating across 30+ mainnet networks, including Monad, Polygon, NEAR and AtomOne, with approximately $10M in total AuM.

Website: https://pathrocknetwork.org
Gno.land Explorer: https://explorer.gnoland.pathrocknetwork.org/
Gno.land Archive RPC: https://gnoland.archive.pathrocknetwork.org/

Contact:
Discord: paddyson
Email: pathrock@protonmail.com
Telegram: @pathrock

We discovered Gno.land through the AtomOne ecosystem and are interested in supporting its approach to on-chain development, governance and decentralized infrastructure.

Our current Gno.land contributions include operating a public mainnet explorer and archive RPC infrastructure. We also participated in the recent Gno.land testnet/validator onboarding process. Going forward, we plan to maintain public RPC/archive services, provide verified node snapshots, contribute monitoring and operator tooling, participate in future testnets and upgrades, and support other validators and community members through the operator channels.
